clipes.prompt: Locked-off close-up, the camera never moves. Keep the desk, the calculator, the bills, the laptop glow and the woman's hands exactly as in the start frame. Her right index finger slowly presses a few calculator keys, one by one; the paper roll prints and advances a little. Her left hand lifts the top bill a few centimeters, she holds it for a moment as if reading the amount, then lays it back down exactly where it was. The laptop light flickers faintly. At the end both hands return to the exact starting position, so the last frame matches the first frame and the clip loops seamlessly. Quiet, tired, realistic motion at real speed.

Security camera footage (CCTV) from a fixed ceiling camera: completely static locked-off shot, no camera movement. Keep the room, the lighting and Dr. Lucas (face, beard, hair, white lab coat over black t-shirt) exactly as in the start frame. Alone in his empty office, Dr. Lucas performs an energetic, slightly awkward social media dance trend in front of the ring light: a few steps side to side, arm waves, a quick spin, points at the phone on the tripod and ends with a pose and a big grin. Then he walks to the tripod, checks the phone screen, nods, steps back to his starting spot and starts the same dance again. Meanwhile, on the desk, the second smartphone vibrates again and again, its screen lighting up with incoming notifications and buzzing slightly across the desk; he never looks at it. He stays fully visible the whole time. Natural motion at real speed.

clipes.prompt: Intimate locked-off close-up from the passenger seat, only a very subtle handheld drift. Keep Dr. Caio (face, skin tone, teal scrubs, badge), the car interior and the dawn light exactly as in the start frame. The car is parked and the engine is off. He sits completely still with both hands on the steering wheel, staring ahead through the windshield, mouth closed the whole time: he never speaks. He blinks slowly, his chest rises in a long tired breath and falls, his thumbs tighten on the wheel and then relax, he lowers his eyes for a moment and looks ahead again. Outside, the dawn sky slowly brightens and a car passes far in the background, out of focus. Melancholic, quiet, realistic, real speed.
